CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_link_loyalty_member(p_profile_id uuid, p_loyalty_member_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_role text;
begin
  -- Verify caller is admin/super_admin
  select role into v_role
  from public.profiles
  where id = auth.uid();

  if v_role is null or v_role not in ('admin', 'super_admin') then
    raise exception 'Access denied';
  end if;

  -- Unlink anything currently connected to this profile
  update public.loyalty_members
    set user_id = null
  where user_id = p_profile_id;

  update public.profiles
    set loyalty_account_id = null
  where id = p_profile_id;

  -- Unlink anything currently connected to this loyalty member
  update public.profiles
    set loyalty_account_id = null
  where loyalty_account_id = p_loyalty_member_id;

  update public.loyalty_members
    set user_id = null
  where id = p_loyalty_member_id;

  -- Link both sides
  update public.loyalty_members
    set user_id = p_profile_id
  where id = p_loyalty_member_id;

  update public.profiles
    set loyalty_account_id = p_loyalty_member_id
  where id = p_profile_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_birthday_vouchers()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN

  INSERT INTO vouchers (
    code,
    reward_text,
    issued_at,
    expires_at,
    status,
    member_id,
    reward_index,
    reward_type
  )
  SELECT
    'BDAY-' || lm.id,
    'Free Birthday Drink / Waffle 🎂',
    NOW(),
    NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days',
    'active',
    lm.id,
    1,
    'birthday'
  FROM loyalty_members lm
  WHERE

    -- ✅ ONLY VALID FORMAT ALLOWED
    lm."Note" ~ '^\d{4}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2}$'

  AND TO_CHAR(
        TO_DATE(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'),
        'MM-DD'
      ) = TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'MM-DD')

  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM vouchers v
    WHERE v.member_id = lm.id
    AND v.reward_type = 'birthday'
    AND DATE_TRUNC('year', COALESCE(v.created_at, v.issued_at))
        = DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW())
  );

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_birthday_vouchers_ph()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  manila_today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Manila')::date;
  manila_year  int  := extract(year from (now() at time zone 'Asia/Manila'))::int;
begin
  /*
    Only process birthdays stored in Note as YYYY-Mon-DD
    Example: 1995-Dec-25
    Invalid formats are skipped safely.
  */

  insert into public.vouchers (
    member_id,
    reward_index,
    code,
    reward_text,
    issued_at,
    expires_at,
    status,
    reward_type,
    created_at
  )
  select
    lm.id as member_id,

    -- avoid conflicts even if you still have UNIQUE(member_id, reward_index)
    coalesce((select max(v.reward_index) from public.vouchers v where v.member_id = lm.id), 0) + 1 as reward_index,

    -- code includes year (prevents duplicates + easy debugging)
    'BDAY' || manila_year::text || '-' || lm.id::text as code,

    '🎂 FREE Birthday Drink or Waffle' as reward_text,

    -- issued_at = start of validity window (00:00 Manila, 2 days before birthday)
    (
      (
        (make_date(
          manila_year,
          extract(month from to_date(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'))::int,
          extract(day   from to_date(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'))::int
        ) - 2)
        ::timestamp
      ) at time zone 'Asia/Manila'
    ) as issued_at,

    -- expires_at = end of validity window (23:59:59 Manila, 2 days after birthday)
    (
      (
        ((make_date(
          manila_year,
          extract(month from to_date(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'))::int,
          extract(day   from to_date(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'))::int
        ) + 2)
        ::timestamp + time '23:59:59')
      ) at time zone 'Asia/Manila'
    ) as expires_at,

    'active' as status,
    'birthday' as reward_type,
    now() as created_at

  from public.loyalty_members lm

  where
    -- accept ONLY the correct format; avoids crashes like "11/1998"
    lm."Note" ~ '^\d{4}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2}$'

    -- compute window dates in Manila and check if today is within [bday-2, bday+2]
    and manila_today between
      (make_date(
        manila_year,
        extract(month from to_date(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'))::int,
        extract(day   from to_date(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'))::int
      ) - 2)
      and
      (make_date(
        manila_year,
        extract(month from to_date(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'))::int,
        extract(day   from to_date(lm."Note", 'YYYY-Mon-DD'))::int
      ) + 2)

    -- prevent duplicates: only 1 birthday voucher per member per year
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.vouchers v
      where v.member_id = lm.id
        and coalesce(v.reward_type, '') = 'birthday'
        and extract(year from (coalesce(v.created_at, v.issued_at) at time zone 'Asia/Manila'))::int = manila_year
    );

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_reward_voucher(p_member_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  current_points INT;
  next_index INT;
BEGIN

  SELECT "Available points"
  INTO current_points
  FROM loyalty_members
  WHERE id = p_member_id;

  -- Only create if reached 100
  IF current_points < 100 THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Next reward index
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(reward_index),0) + 1
  INTO next_index
  FROM vouchers
  WHERE member_id = p_member_id
  AND reward_type = 'reward';

  INSERT INTO vouchers (
    code,
    reward_text,
    issued_at,
    expires_at,
    status,
    member_id,
    reward_index,
    reward_type
  )
  VALUES (
    'RW-' || next_index || '-' || p_member_id,
    'Free Drink / Mini Donut / Waffle Reward 🎁',
    NOW(),
    NOW() + INTERVAL '90 days',
    'active',
    p_member_id,
    next_index,
    'reward'
  );

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_vouchers()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  UPDATE public.vouchers
  SET status = 'expired'
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND expires_at <= now();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.next_loyalty_customer_code()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_code_year text := to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Manila', 'YYYY');
  v_next_number bigint;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('loyalty_customer_code_gap_reuse'));

  with used_numbers as (
    select substring(customer_code from '^JUJA[0-9]{4}([0-9]{6})$')::bigint as n
    from public.loyalty_members
    where customer_code ~ '^JUJA[0-9]{10}$'
  ),
  candidate_numbers as (
    select generate_series(
      1,
      greatest(1, (select coalesce(max(n), 0) + 1 from used_numbers))
    ) as n
  )
  select candidate_numbers.n
  into v_next_number
  from candidate_numbers
  left join used_numbers on used_numbers.n = candidate_numbers.n
  where used_numbers.n is null
  order by candidate_numbers.n
  limit 1;

  return 'JUJA' || v_code_year || lpad(coalesce(v_next_number, 1)::text, 6, '0');
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_voucher_status()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin

  update vouchers
  set status = 'expired'
  where expires_at < now()
  and status = 'active';

  update vouchers
  set status = 'redeemed'
  where redeemed_at is not null;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_voucher_status_ph()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin

  -- ✅ mark redeemed first
  update public.vouchers
  set status = 'redeemed'
  where redeemed_at is not null
    and status <> 'redeemed';

  -- ✅ mark expired (proper completion)
  update public.vouchers
  set status = 'expired'
  where status = 'active'
    and expires_at is not null
    and expires_at <= now();

end;
$function$
